caption: Figure 8. A demonstration of (a) registering vCPU as native CPU on OS and (b) intercepting and routing IPIs.
subject: how Tai Chi registers a vCPU as a native CPU and then intercepts/routes each inter-processor interrupt via source/destination CPU-state checks

groups.why_chosen: A registration timeline sets up vCPU-as-CPU, then one decision-diamond template — with the same little CPU-state lookup table inside — is reused twice for source and destination routing.
groups.what_to_learn: Embed the literal small state-lookup table inside the decision diamond itself, reuse that exact diamond+table shape for both the source and destination check, and bracket the two halves in one accent colour to name the phases.
